paths.label: For Miners
paths.title: Clean energy earns more
paths.body: Mine with verified clean energy and mint SBP tokens alongside the Bitcoin you produce — a second revenue stream for the same work, and a direct line to climate-mandated capital.

paths.label: For Investors
paths.title: SBP tokens make Bitcoin climate-aligned
paths.body: Pairing BTC with SBP tokens gives climate-aligned capital a verifiable way to invest in Bitcoin — clean-energy proof with the audit trail mandates require.
